source_text: The Shulchan Aruch (Yoreh De'ah 260-261) explicitly mandates that a father must circumcise his son; if he neglects this, the rabbinic court (beit din) is obligated to intervene and perform it, and upon maturity, the individual himself bears the responsibility, underscoring the non-optional nature of the act. [28]
